title: AgentCore configuration document, apiVersion agentcore/v1
description: Check 1 of section 8.5. Shape only. Checks 2 to 8 run after this one.

apiVersion.description: The only version this schema accepts.

name.description: The name of the configured agent.

fallbackReply.description: Section 8.7: the line the caller hears when a turn fails. It sits at the root because every document shape speaks it. The default is the sentence AgentCore ships.

refusalReply.description: The line the caller hears when the agent refuses to answer. Content moderation reads the caller's spoken input before the model runs, and the agent refuses the turn when the endpoint flags it. It sits at the root beside fallbackReply because every document shape speaks it. The key is optional, and the default is the sentence AgentCore ships. fallbackReply cannot serve here: its default asks the caller to say it again, which invites the harmful request a second time, and section 8.7 gives fallbackReply to a turn that failed, while a refusal never asks the model at all.

state.description: The declared state slots. Guards read only these and the three reserved slots.

guards.description: A guard name mapped to a raw JSONLogic rule.

mcp.description: Decision 13: declared MCP servers, each becoming many tools once discovery runs.

graph.description: Section 8.2: a document that holds both policy and graph is a load-time error.

toolReference.description: A tool id an agent references. It carries one optional dot because decision 10 serves an MCP tool as <server>.<tool>; a tools: entry's own id never has one.

skillName.description: A skill name. It is not #/$defs/identifier, because MAF's AgentSkillFrontmatter.ValidateName imposes this charset, so an identifier such as Warranty_Returns names a skill no folder can ever serve.

rule.description: A raw JSONLogic rule. Section 8.4 checks its operators, and this schema does not type it.

ref.description: The `as` name of one entry in providers.llm.

default.description: The value the slot holds before any writer fills it.

items.description: A member with no value enumerates nothing. Check 5 walks these points and the slot carries a declared type, so null is never one of them.

enum.description: The members check 5 enumerates for this slot.

from.description: writer: tool. A tool id, a dot, then a path into the tool result.

increment.description: writer: counter. The slot increments whenever this rule is true.

value.description: writer: const. The fixed value of the slot.

when.description: Section 8.3: agentcore/v1 defines no second value.

titler.description: The model that names a call from its first few messages. The key is optional, and a document that omits it leaves the titler on the default providers.llm entry.

uses.description: kind: builtin. The name of the built-in the tool calls.

binds.description: kind: binding. The name of the host delegate the tool calls.

agent.description: kind: agent. The id of the agents.items entry this tool runs. Check 8 walks this field.

parameters.description: The raw JSON Schema of the tool arguments. This schema does not type it.

model.description: kind: builtin naming a shipped agent. The model that inner agent runs on. Omitted, the host default applies.

maxRounds.description: kind: builtin naming a shipped agent. The round cap inside that tool, not the calling agent's turn budget.

then.$comment: kind: builtin reads fixed argument names in C# (BuiltinToolSource). A document that overrides the schema makes the model fill boxes the C# never reads, so parameters is forbidden here.

Only the kind: builtin path reads model and maxRounds (ShippedAgentBuilder). A kind: agent tool takes its model from its agents.items entry, and http and binding call no model at all, so either key there would be accepted and then ignored.

mcpServer.description: Decision 13: one MCP server. One entry becomes many tools once discovery runs.

id.description: Decision 10: every tool this server offers is served as <id>.<tool>, unless allow[].as renames it.

transport.description: How AgentCore reaches the server: a child process over its standard streams, or an HTTP endpoint.

command.description: transport: stdio. The executable and its arguments that launch the server.

headers.description: transport: http. Headers sent on every request. A value may hold ${secret:name}. This is where an Authorization header goes.

env.description: transport: stdio. The environment the child process is launched with. A value may hold ${secret:name}. A credential goes here, never in command:, where it would land in ps.

inheritEnv.description: transport: stdio. Whether the child also inherits this process's own environment. Defaults to false: an MCP server is third-party code, and inheriting hands it every other credential this process holds.

connectTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one connection attempt may take. Applied on every attempt, so the SDK's own 60s default never governs.

callTimeoutSeconds.description: How long one tool call on this server may take before it is cancelled and the model is told it timed out.

retry.description: What happens when a connection attempt fails. Exists for cold starts: npx fetching a package, or a container still warming up.

attempts.description: The number of attempts, including the first.

backoffMs.description: The wait before the second attempt. Each later one waits twice the last.

allow.description: Decision 6: the tools this server is pinned to offer. Pinning is the default; ["*"] is the explicit opt-out.

then.$comment: transport: stdio launches a child process; url names nothing there, and a header belongs to no request it makes. Its credential goes in env:.
transport: http reaches a server already running; nothing here launches a process, so there is no child environment to set. Its credential goes in headers:.

mcpAllowEntry.description: Decision 6: a tool name, or a single-key object aliasing it to a served id.

oneOf.description: The tool name as the server offers it, or "*" for every tool it offers.
One tool name mapped to the object that aliases it. The key is the remote server's own tool name, whose shape this schema does not control.

as.description: Decision 10: the id this tool is served under, instead of <server>.<tool>. A bare id, like every other tools: entry.

headers.description: A value may hold one or more ${secret:name} references.

instructions.description: The stable cached prefix. Each stage appends a delta below it.

limit.description: How many cards to retrieve. The store fetches once per search and every agent shares that one fetch, so no agent may ask for more than the store itself retrieves.

onNoMatch.description: Section 8.5: a stage may reject the zero-guards-true case.

when.description: A guard name, or an inline JSONLogic rule.

agents.description: The participants of a pattern graph, in order.

start.description: Check 7 needs exactly one start node.

output.description: Check 7 needs every path to reach an output node.

when.description: A guard name, or an inline JSONLogic rule.

moderation.description: The adapter that reads what the caller said through a moderation endpoint, such as openai. A document that names none moderates nothing.

embeddings.description: The vendor that turns a query into a vector, such as openai. A knowledge store that ranks by vector needs one.

telemetry.description: Where traces, metrics, and logs are exported to. A document that names none exports nothing.

audit.description: Where the D23 audit chain is written, such as memory. A document that names none uses the in-process memory sink, which is not durable.

calls.description: Where a call is kept: its row, and the words of it. A document that names none uses the in-process memory store, which is not durable and holds no retention window.

as.description: The name a modelRef points at.

reasoningEffort.description: How hard a reasoning model thinks before it answers. Omit it to send nothing and let the vendor decide. Some reasoning models refuse function tools on the chat-completions path unless this is 'none'.

speechProvider.description: The two speech roles: stt is recognition, what the caller said turned into text, and tts is synthesis, text turned into what the caller hears. Both are always written out. A transport that carries text is both, and names itself twice.

callProvider.description: The media plane: who carries the call and owns its inbound route. Not providers.speech, which is recognition and synthesis, and not providers.telephony, which is call control.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: How long the socket waits with no inbound frame before ending the call. -1 means never.

closeTimeoutSeconds.description: How long teardown gives a stuck task before moving on. -1 means never.

maxFrameBytes.description: The largest inbound frame the socket accepts. The ceiling is int.MaxValue, which is the largest buffer length the socket can be given.

evaluation.description: Triage row T18: the share of finished turns a judge scores. D9 keeps the judge off the turn.

sampleRate.description: The share of finished turns to evaluate, from 0 through 1. The default of 0 evaluates none.

judge.description: The model that scores a turn. The online sampled path and the offline golden set both read it. The key is optional, and a document that omits it runs only the evaluators that call no model.

embeddingProvider.description: The vendor that turns a query into a vector, and the model it uses.

model.description: The model name the vendor knows, such as text-embedding-3-small.

dimensions.description: The vector width to ask the vendor for. Omit it for the model's own width. It must match the width the knowledge collection was built with.

knowledgeProvider.description: The adapter that answers IKnowledgeRetrievalPort, and what it reads. AgentCore ships no payload field names: every role below is unmapped until this block names it.

kind.description: The adapter that answers IKnowledgeRetrievalPort, such as qdrant.

endpoint.description: The Qdrant endpoint, such as https://qdrant.example.com:6334.

collection.description: The collection to read. Point it at an alias if your ingester swaps collections on rebuild.

vector.description: The named vector every query searches. Omitted or null, the collection's single anonymous vector is searched.

fields.description: How a card's payload is named, in this collection. A dotted name walks into a nested struct. There are no defaults: a role this block does not name is absent from the card. Required unless mapper: names a point mapper instead.

id.description: The card id. Unmapped, the point's own key stands in.

body.description: What the model reads. The one role the built-in mapping cannot do without.

lexical.description: The full-text-indexed field the required-term leg matches on. Unmapped, the search ranks by vector alone.

locator.description: Where in that source the card sits.

authority.description: The trust rank. Read by the audit record only.

scope.description: How an open KnowledgeScope's facet keys become payload paths. Required whenever any agent declares knowledge: { scoped: true }.

template.description: The payload path each facet key becomes, with {key} standing for the key. Flat facets are {key}; facets nested under one struct are facets.{key}.

links.description: How a card's links to other cards are read and followed. Writing the block turns link expansion on and requires a mapped fields.id; omitting it turns the feature off.

field.description: The payload field holding the ids of the cards this card links to.

lookup.description: How a linked id becomes a point to fetch. filter works on any collection; uuid5 and direct derive the point key from the id.

namespace.description: The uuid5 namespace: url, dns, oid, x500, or a GUID. RFC 4122's own names; uuid5 is undefined without one.

prefix.description: What the ingester puts in front of the id before hashing. Empty by default.

analyzer.description: The IKnowledgeQueryAnalyzer name that picks required terms. Defaults to none, which requires nothing and ranks by vector alone.

mapper.description: The IKnowledgePointMapper name that turns a point into a card. Omitted, the fields: block is the mapper.

citation.description: The IKnowledgeCitationFormatter name that writes each card's source label. Read only by agents that declare citations: true. Register your own with options.UseKnowledgeCitationFormatters.

scoreFloor.description: The smallest fused score a card may carry.

kind.description: The vendor that exports the signals, such as grafana.

endpoint.description: The collector URL. Left out, the OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT variable answers instead.

serviceName.description: The service.name every exported signal carries. Defaults to agentcore.

exportIntervalMs.description: How often metrics are sent. T61 puts a floor of 60000 under it, and a smaller number is raised to that floor. The bounds are int.MinValue and int.MaxValue, the range the exporter's period is expressed in.

sources.description: Extra ActivitySource names listened to, beside the one AgentCore owns. An empty array listens to AgentCore alone. A name of nothing but spaces listens to nothing, so it is refused.

meters.description: Extra Meter names listened to, beside the one AgentCore owns. These are the bulk of the active series item 12 caps at 10,000. A name of nothing but spaces listens to nothing, so it is refused.
